prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for adoption (new_screen, redesign), home (new_flow), and sign_in (reorder) changes because only one test has been completed for each.
Evidence is still thin for finish (new_screen) changes because the two completed tests disagreed on outcome.
Predictions were consistently too high across tests.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_screen: -2.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: +0.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -0.3% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- home, new_flow: -8.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: +0.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 77.0%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 21.2%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Two Column Adoption Certificate Creator: Redesigns the adoption certificate screen into a side-by-side two-column layout showing dynamic pet naming on the left and certificate preview on the right. (why: Adoption has the highest friction in the funnel with only 60.9% conversion and a median time of 89s.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Post Adoption Sign In Placement: Moves the sign-in step to occur after pet selection and adoption certificate creation instead of right after choose path. (why: Sign-in currently sits before users pick their pet (72.9% conversion), creating early drop-off before emotional investment in a specific companion.)
2: [home, new_flow] Background Pet Preparation Status Stream: Transforms the waiting screen into a dynamic multi-stage preparation flow with live status indicators while the pet generates in the background. (why: The waiting screen has a high median time of 201s and mean of 2336s, leading to high drop-offs if users assume the app frozen.)
3: [choose_path, hint] Companion Creation Time Estimate Hint: Displays a clear time expectation hint on the path selection screen letting users know setup takes under 2 minutes. (why: The choose_path step has a mean duration of 514s, suggesting users linger or hesitate before committing to a path.)
4: [home, notification] Background Hatching Desktop Notification Prompt: Adds an explicit desktop notification opt-in toggle on the waiting screen so users can safely switch windows while waiting. (why: Waiting step takes over 3 minutes median time, causing users to minimize or forget the desktop application.)
5: [sign_in, copy] Cloud Sync Account Preservation Copy: Updates the sign-in screen messaging to clearly explain that signing in saves and syncs pet progress to cloud storage. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing in again with different credentials.)
6: [adoption, incentive] Adoption Certificate Mascot Stamp Badge: Adds an animated official adoption seal badge upon completing pet naming on the certificate screen. (why: Adoption has a steep 39.1% drop-off; adding a visual reward accentuates accomplishment.)
7: [home, wait_info] Pet Hatching Progress Tip Carousel: Adds an automatic rotating tip carousel explaining pet personalities and desktop interaction tips while waiting. (why: Mean time spent waiting is 2336s; engaging content during the wait reduces drop-off and prepares users for desktop controls.)
8: [choose_path, redesign] Full Bleed Companion Story Intro: Redesigns the initial intro story screen into an immersive full-bleed mascot visual showcasing companion interactions. (why: The choose_path initial step has a mean duration of 514s; a strong emotional hook improves early conversion.)

scores.note: Adoption has highest drop-off (39.1%), but redesign cost is high and past lift was small (+0.4%).
Reordering sign-in builds emotional investment; previous test showed modest +0.8% lift.
Home step has long wait, but past home new_flow test yielded severe negative results (-8.2%).
Low-cost copy addition targeting high linger time at choose_path.
Helps prevent drop-off during long 201s median wait by enabling background notifications.
Both funnel drop-off and 8 support emails confirm sign-in confusion; cheap copy fix.
Targets highest friction step (adoption 60.9%) with visual reward incentive.
Addresses extreme mean wait time (2336s) by entertaining users during setup.
High effort visual overhaul on step with relatively good conversion (76.2%).
